newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim, Warsaw form bridge venture.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim, Warsaw form bridge venture.

text.p: Polish trading and industrial conglomerate Elektrim SA on Friday formed a joint venture with Warsaw central district authorities to build a bridge across the Vistula river.

Warsaw mayor Marcin Swiecicki told a news conference Elektrim would invest 15 million Ecus in the construction in return for a piece of land on the eastern bank of the river, which it wants for redevelopment.

Elektrim will have 51 percent in the new venture, called Trasa Swietokrzyska, with the city holding the rest. The total cost of the bridge construction is estimated at 150 million zlotys. Work is due to start next year.
Elektrim president Andrzej Skowronski said his company planned to create a financial and commercial centre near the bridge.
Elektrim and city officials said the construction of the new bridge would be financed internally and no debt issues were planned.
